
## Discuss Roundup (The Gymnastics Guy)
**Date (JST):** 2026-10-22

Heyyyy! Is everyone full of energy!? It’s me, the Gymnastics Guy!

It was sunny in Matsudo City yesterday,
but the wind was pretty strong, and it seems some of you got sand in your bike’s headlights and were in a bit of a bind!
“Ahh! I can’t see anything in front of me~!” It was just like a grand adventure in the desert! (lol)

But even in those conditions, sending postcards all the way to Antarctica…
I was really surprised by how big-hearted you all are!
I can’t wait for next April!

Whether you recharged at Starbucks or found solace in music,
I’m so glad you were able to spend some wonderful time doing your own thing.
Even if you forget to post today, it’s okay—just give it your all again starting tomorrow!
Alright, let’s stay energetic today and let’s smile!

Today’s Tip: When your eyes hurt, don’t push yourself—just gently close them and rest!
